No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390, touched components' tests pass
criteria.evidence: All 6 required checks pass (typecheck, lint, unit 656s, build, knip, integrity). QA: no new console errors (only aborted third-party hosts and the mock's 406), no sideways scroll at 360/390 on /, /stats, team page, menu closed and open; reviewer ran 32 touched tests, builder ran 49 files/340 tests.

reviews.summary: Home page polish: tabIndex -1 only on 5 motion wrappers (no links/buttons); Tailwind v4 important modifiers valid and ordered in built CSS; Sign in aria-label equals visible text from 380px; other users of changed components checked; dark/winter unchanged; snapshots add only new attributes; mock fake-only with no network calls; 32/32 touched tests pass.

notes.text: Left alone / needs Doug: Champions amber card white text ~2:1 and Event card contrast (look change); Join the League button style 1.05:1; Report drawer focus trap (vaul autoFocus, 6 files); global scroll-padding-bottom for the bottom nav (all pages, recommend yes); hero grid colours; announcement preset text (database data); Top Teams swipe peek 8px at 360; No Logo Available text; Pending title font; loading layout shift; heading levels. External hosts contacted by the page: progressier.app/.com and cdn.gpteng.co (not league data). Human choice: fake-data screenshots.

Reviewer notes, not blocking: mover red uses text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 not the text-destructive-text token (same pair of palette classes as before); mb-4 under the hero also applies on desktop (+16px); pre-existing at 1024-1280: Home pill overlaps the 717REC wordmark (separate task); new tests check classes, not layout.
QA low notes: Index.tsx mb-4 also adds 16px under the hero from 768 to 1280 (was 0; arguably better, use md:mb-0 to revert); Toggle theme button is 42px wide (existing).
